gloss: a fixed amount; a set amount of money

definitions.gloss: a fixed amount of money; a set sum
definitions.explanation: A predetermined, set sum of money — for example, a fixed monthly allowance, a flat fee, a fixed deductible, or a threshold below which special rules apply. {一定額|いっていがく} appears constantly in financial, legal, tax, and contractual writing where a numeric amount is held constant or compared against a threshold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{一定額|いっていがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I save a fixed amount every month.

examples.japanese: {一定額|いっていがく}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支出|ししゅつ}→支出：03169_shishutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Expenditures above a fixed amount require the approval of a superior.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一定額|いっていがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧。
examples.english: Under this system, you fall outside the scope of support if your income exceeds a fixed amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老後|ろうご}→老後：15131_rougo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{備|そな}え→備え：11620_sonae⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一定額|いっていがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投資信託|とうししんたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}している→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
examples.english: As preparation for old age, I automatically channel a fixed amount from my salary into mutual funds.

notes:
{一定額|いっていがく} is a standard administrative and financial term meaning "a fixed amount" of money.

FORMS:
- ⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧ ("fixed, set, constant") + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (from ⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧ "amount of money") → {一定額|いっていがく}

USAGE:
- Personal finance and saving plans ({一定額|いっていがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ "to save a fixed amount")
- Tax and welfare thresholds ({一定額|いっていがく}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧ "income above a certain amount")
- Insurance deductibles, copay caps, and grant limits
- Corporate expense-approval rules
- Government subsidies and benefit programs
- {一定額|いっていがく}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧ is an extremely common phrase in administrative and policy writing, equivalent to "a certain (specified) amount or more" in English.
- For consumer subscription pricing ("flat rate"), ⟦{定額|ていがく}{制|せい}→定額制：17050_teigakusei⟧ is the standard label, not {一定額|いっていがく}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一定額|いっていがく}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧: a fixed amount or more (a threshold above which something applies)
- {一定額|いっていがく}⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧: a fixed amount or less (a threshold below which something applies)
- {一定額|いっていがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed a fixed amount
- {一定額|いっていがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach a fixed amount
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{一定額|いっていがく}: a fixed amount each month
- {一定額|いっていがく}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: up to a fixed amount

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧: fixed, set, constant — the broader adjective; modifies many nouns (⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ "certain conditions")
- ⟦{定額|ていがく}→定額：09740_teigaku⟧: fixed amount, flat rate — closely related and often interchangeable; ⟦{定額|ていがく}{制|せい}→定額制：17050_teigakusei⟧ "flat-rate plan" is a common service category. ⟦{定額|ていがく}→定額：09740_teigaku⟧ feels more set-in-advance / contractual; {一定額|いっていがく} more often functions as "a (single) certain amount" used as a threshold.
- ⟦{限度額|げんどがく}→限度額：20870_gendogaku⟧: maximum amount, ceiling
- ⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧ / ⟦{下限|かげん}→下限：11385_kagen⟧: upper / lower limit
- ⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧: monetary amount (general)
